svg.title: GrimGlow Issue 7 — Page 9 — "Moving Through It" — Section 3 closes, Thresh chooses to function
svg.desc: Page 9: 4 panels in 3 tiers (full / half-half / full). Section 3 closes. Dual portrait — Luma's calm and Thresh's red-rimmed eyes facing each other in the stone groove, fear named not mastered. Thresh stands, checks her weapon, decides to function. Luma watches her go — worry showing only because her back is turned, Theodore behind a crate has seen the near-miss and is white-faced. Thresh walks the pier alone toward overwatch, the lighthouse rising at the far end, the beam sweeping overhead.
